note: The parts of a mainframe estate that are not on the mainframe, and so are pinned to a version in a build file this tool reads. What runs on the mainframe has its own public record and its own worklist in z-attack-classes.json, swept by diag/sweep-z.mjs; nothing pins a z/OS version in a repository, so those advisories drive rule design rather than version arithmetic. No general-purpose scanner looks for these components in a COBOL repository. Counts are repositories of the 125-repository public corpus that name the component at all.

components.pinnedAs: ctgclient.jar or com.ibm.ctg coordinates in a build file, or a CTG image tag
db2jcc or com.ibm.db2.jcc coordinates, or a Db2 Connect image tag
com.ibm.mq.allclient coordinates or an MQ image tag. The client ships the queue manager's version, so an advisory against the server names the client this matches
@zowe/* in package.json, or a zowe CLI version in a pipeline
the COBOL language support extension in a devcontainer or extensions list
